title: JEB A Very Grinchy Family Night
seo_title: JEB A Very Grinchy Family Night in Lebanon, MO
description: JEB A Very Grinchy Family Night is a free family event with Grinchy learning and an interactive story at 4:15 pm in the Cafeteria, followed by movie night at 6:00 pm in the gyms, with a live version in the Main Gym and an animated version in the FEMA Gym. It is for JEB families, and students may not attend without a parent or guardian; each person gets a free bag of popcorn, concessions are sold at regular prices, and guests can bring blankets and chairs. It takes place December 3, 2026 (Time TBD, doors at 5:15 pm) at 16050 Highway KK in Lebanon, MO.
